authorization_mode.Description: Optional. The authorization mode of the Redis cluster. If not provided, auth feature is disabled for the cluster. Default value: "AUTH_MODE_DISABLED" Possible values: ["AUTH_MODE_UNSPECIFIED", "AUTH_MODE_IAM_AUTH", "AUTH_MODE_DISABLED"]

create_time.Description:
The timestamp associated with the cluster creation request. A timestamp in
RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional
digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

discovery_endpoints.Description:
Output only. Endpoints created on each given network,
for Redis clients to connect to the cluster.
Currently only one endpoint is supported.

address.Description: Output only. Network address of the exposed Redis endpoint used by clients to connect to the service.

port.Description: Output only. The port number of the exposed Redis endpoint.

psc_config.Description:
Output only. Customer configuration for where the endpoint
is created and accessed from.

network.Description:
The consumer network where the network address of the discovery
endpoint will be reserved, in the form of
projects/{network_project_id}/global/networks/{network_id}.

name.Description:
Unique name of the resource in this scope including project and location using the form:
projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/clusters/{clusterId}

psc_configs.Description:
Required. Each PscConfig configures the consumer network where two
network addresses will be designated to the cluster for client access.
Currently, only one PscConfig is supported.

network.Description:
Required. The consumer network where the network address of
the discovery endpoint will be reserved, in the form of
projects/{network_project_id_or_number}/global/networks/{network_id}.

psc_connections.Description: Output only. PSC connections for discovery of the cluster topology and accessing the cluster.

address.Description: Output only. The IP allocated on the consumer network for the PSC forwarding rule.

forwarding_rule.Description: Output only. The URI of the consumer side forwarding rule. Example: projects/{projectNumOrId}/regions/us-east1/forwardingRules/{resourceId}.

network.Description: The consumer network where the IP address resides, in the form of projects/{projectId}/global/networks/{network_id}.

project_id.Description: Output only. The consumer projectId where the forwarding rule is created from.

psc_connection_id.Description: Output only. The PSC connection id of the forwarding rule connected to the service attachment.

region.Description: The name of the region of the Redis cluster.

replica_count.Description: Optional. The number of replica nodes per shard.

shard_count.Description: Required. Number of shards for the Redis cluster.

size_gb.Description: Output only. Redis memory size in GB for the entire cluster.

state.Description: The current state of this cluster. Can be CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DELETING and SUSPENDED

state_info.Description: Output only. Additional information about the current state of the cluster.

target_replica_count.Description: Target number of replica nodes per shard.

target_shard_count.Description: Target number of shards for redis cluster.

transit_encryption_mode.Description:
Optional. The in-transit encryption for the Redis cluster.
If not provided, encryption is disabled for the cluster. Default value: "TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION_MODE_DISABLED" Possible values: ["TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION_MODE_UNSPECIFIED", "TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION_MODE_DISABLED", "TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION_MODE_SERVER_AUTHENTICATION"]

uid.Description: System assigned, unique identifier for the cluster.
